items.name: FTO Tour Strzelce Opolskie 2027
items.information:
![](https://i.imgur.com/y4aZ08M.png) **Polski:** Serdecznie zapraszamy na drugi turniej FTO Tour - serii dziewięciu zawodów w Południowej Polsce z FTO jako główną konkurencją!
Partnerem wydarzenia jest Powiatowe Centrum Kultury w Strzelcach Opolskich.

-----------------------
![](https://i.imgur.com/i1ldA95.png) **English:** We cordially invite you to the second competition of the FTO Tour – a series of nine competitions in Southern Poland featuring FTO as the main event! 
Powiatowe Centrum Kultury in Strzelce Opolskie is the competition's partner.

items.name: Imagination Station B 2027

venue.name: [Imagination Station](https://www.imaginationstationtoledo.org/)
venue.details: Exploration Center - on the lower floor next to the cafeteria

items.information:
This competition is at the Imagination Station science center. Non-competing family members and spectators are **required to purchase general admission** to the science center to enter the competition. Competitors will pick up their lanyards at the front desk and will not need to purchase general admission.

Imagination Station opens at 12pm - you will not be able to get in earlier.
